no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: All four product candidates (SPC-15, SP-26, SPC-14, SPU-16) are still preclinical or IND-pending. Lead asset SPC-15 had a pre-IND meeting with FDA in September 2024 and is targeting IND submission in 2026; Phase 1 SAD/MAD studies with Allucent are planned but not yet initiated. SP-26 is in preclinical research. SPC-14 and SPU-16 are early discovery/preclinical.

excluded_preclinical.status: IND-enabling GLP toxicology ongoing; IND submission targeted 2026; Phase 1 planned with Allucent
